text: Sufficient power, and this is good, if we want to provide a large coverage. However, if we look at the antenna size, the antenna size is more or less of the same order of magnitude as the wavelength. And so, if we have a high frequency of the signal, the wavelength is smaller, and the antenna size will be smaller. Whenever you want to design a mobile device, you want a mobile device that is small. So every everything that you put inside needs to be small. So from that point of view, using higher frequencies is a good thing because we can have a smaller antenna. As we said, however, the higher the frequency at which we transmit the signal, the larger the attenuation. So in that case, if the antenna is small, the frequency is high, the antenna is small, but unfortunately, the signal will be received by a far away receiver, very weak. So it's a trade off, right? It's a trade off. Here we need to think about what we want to do with our wireless signal. Do we want to connect devices that are close to each other? Well, then the receiver, the transmitter will be close. Our signal doesn't need to travel too far away. This means that we can cope with higher frequency.
